name: backlog-artifact
description: Publishes a Backlog.md backlog as a phone-friendly page, either as a claude.ai Artifact or to your own backlog server, refreshed after turns that change it.

publish_target.title: Publish to
publish_target.description: artifact: a claude.ai Artifact (each publish costs one extra Claude step). server: upload straight to your backlog server (no model cost).

auto_publish.title: Publish automatically
auto_publish.description: After a turn that changed the backlog, ask Claude to publish the page. Off: the page is only rendered locally; publish with /backlog-artifact:publish.

publish_interval_minutes.title: Minimum minutes between publishes
publish_interval_minutes.description: Artifact mode only: changes made sooner than this after the last publish wait for a later turn. Each publish costs one extra Claude step over the session's context. 0 publishes after every changed turn. Server mode publishes every change.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Server mode: the backlog server, e.g. https://backlog.example.com

server_key.title: Server publish token
server_key.description: Server mode: a publish token from the server's publish_tokens file. Leave empty to sign with your SSH key instead.

ssh_key.title: SSH public key file
ssh_key.description: Server mode, when no publish token is set: the public key to sign with (its private key must be in ssh-agent). Empty: the first key ssh-agent lists.

include_drafts.title: Include drafts
include_drafts.description: Show tasks from backlog/drafts as a Draft state.

include_archived.title: Include archived tasks
include_archived.description: Show tasks from backlog/archive/tasks as an Archived state.
